messages:
sam: Quick sync — we need a final mapping for Free / Pro / Enterprise entitlement bands. Main constraints: per-org vs per-key enforcement, burst credits, and what shows up in Console. Posting a concrete proposal below, please react or suggest changes.

sam: Proposal (high level):
- Free: per-key quota, low steady rate, small burst credits.
- Pro: primary enforcement per-org with per-key soft caps; org pool for bursts.
- Enterprise: org-first, configurable isolation (allow lock to per-key if requested), larger burst pool and SLA.

sam: Config snippet idea:
```json
{
  "plans": {
    "free": { "rate_rps": "2", "burst_tokens": "200", "scope": "per_key" },
    "pro":  { "rate_rps": "25", "burst_tokens": "2500", "scope": "per_org", "per_key_soft": "5rps" },
    "enterprise": { "rate_rps": "200", "burst_tokens": "20000", "scope": "org_configurable" }
  }
}
```

maya: +1 on per-org for Pro. Two notes: 1) show both org balance and individual key consumption in Console (status page), 2) free should have a daily refill window not just token bucket so we avoid overnight hoarding.

devon: Concern: if Pro is per-org burst pool, a noisy key can drain it and impact other apps. Suggest: per-key soft cap that auto-throttles at e.g. 5rps and only lets keys borrow from org pool if they stay under a sustained rate for 30s. Means we need tracking window + borrow tokens.

liam: Implementation note — we can represent borrowable pool as two counters: org_bucket and key_bucket. Algorithm: refill_rate = plan.rate_rps; on request consume min(key_bucket, request_cost) then org_bucket. If org_bucket used, mark key as borrowed and apply faster decay if pattern is abusive. Pseudocode: ```consume(request) { if key_bucket >= cost -> key_bucket -= cost; else if org_bucket >= cost -> org_bucket -= cost; else -> deny }```

anika: Console UX — can we surface the following: current_key_rate, key_borrowed_amount, org_pool_remaining, estimated_refill_time. Also a small tooltip: "If your key uses org pool, others may be impacted. Talk to support for isolation."

sam: Good. For billing mapping: free -> no overage, Pro -> soft overage warnings + auto-throttle, Enterprise -> configurable overage or commit-based reserved capacity. Need to ensure telemetry emits: plan_id, scope, borrowed_from_org, deny_reason.

devon: Also add enforcement flags: "strict_per_key" (deny if key hits cap), "allow_borrow" (borrow from org pool), "isolation_required" (enterprise-only toggle). That keeps runtime simple.

ops-bot: rate-limiter-service: test deploy of branch feature/quota-bands succeeded in staging at 2025-10-03T14:12:09Z :white_check_mark:

sam: Next steps — I'll draft a brief RFC with exact numeric bands and the telemetry spec, plus sample Console wireframes. If no objections by EOD tomorrow, we'll ship to alpha.

maya: ack. small ask — add a migration plan for existing Pro customers so they don't unexpectedly lose capacity.

sam: Agreed, will include migration window and opt-out flags. Thanks all.
